task: Finding-level binary classification of ClinSig from frozen 100x100 T2 and ADC patches
evaluation_cycle: For run k, outer fold k is test, fold (k+1) mod 5 is validation, and the remaining three folds are training.
grouping: Patient-level fold assignments are unchanged; all findings from a patient remain together.

primary_analysis.action_for_ProstateX_0052_fid1: Retain exactly as extracted in every applicable split.

sensitivity_analysis.action: Remove the finding before forming train, validation, and test arrays; retrain and rescore every affected run.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Training findings only for each outer-fold cycle and sensitivity variant.
preprocessing.normalization: Per selected channel, subtract the training-pixel mean and divide by the training-pixel standard deviation computed across all training patches and pixels.

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with positive weight equal to training negatives divided by training positives

aggregation.per_run: Report every fold, seed, modality, and variant.
aggregation.summary: Report mean and standard deviation across the 15 fold-seed test evaluations for each modality and variant.
aggregation.pooled_predictions: Retain finding-level scores with full keys and patient identifiers.
aggregation.confidence_intervals: Use patient-level bootstrap resampling so all findings from a sampled patient remain together; 2000 replicates; seed 8675309.

modeling_order: Complete T2-only, ADC-only, and paired fixed-CNN baselines.
Complete the prespecified ProstateX-0052 sensitivity runs.
Only then introduce augmentation, GAN, GA, or hyperparameter-search experiments.
prohibited_actions: Do not change fold assignments after viewing results.
Do not fit normalization on validation or test patches.
Do not use test metrics for early stopping or model selection.
Do not replace excluded or sensitivity-omitted findings.
Do not tune the fixed baseline architecture separately by modality or fold.
Do not claim clinical validation from these experiments.
